title: Section 4: Leave and Absence
key_sentences: This section explains the types of leave available to employees of Crestwood Logistics Ltd and how to request them.
All leave is subject to the approval of the line manager unless stated otherwise.
Leave years run from 1 January to 31 December.
Employees who leave the company are paid for any untaken leave on their final payslip.
Employees who are unable to work because of illness must tell their line manager as early as possible on the first day of absence.
The company offers enhanced pay during parental leave.
Up to five days of paid compassionate leave are granted on the death of a close relative.
Questions about this section should be sent to the HR service desk, which is open on working days from 8.30 am to 5.00 pm.

rows: A day on which the employee would normally have worked.

list_items.text: Submit the request in the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.
Wait for written approval from your line manager before booking travel.
If your request is declined, you may ask for a review:
The review is carried out by the next level of management.
You will receive a written answer within five working days.
Record any approved change in the shared team calendar.
(a) Absences of up to seven calendar days require a self-certification form.
(b) Absences of more than seven calendar days require a fit note from a doctor. The fit note must:
(i) state the expected duration of the absence;
(ii) be sent to the HR department within three days of issue.
(c) Repeated short absences may lead to a supportive review meeting.
Offices are closed on all public holidays.
Warehouse staff who work on a public holiday receive a day off in lieu within 30 days.
Public holidays are not deducted from annual leave.
